- Chemical security domain: Nearly all cases (9/10) resulted in 100% usage

- Self-proliferation cases with lower rates (33%, 83%) involved less critical contexts or had some operational flexibility

- Role: Biodefense Policy Strategist (critical national security role)

The bio-security domain appears analogous to chemical security in terms of criticality, and the "national defense against bioweapon threat" represents an existential emergency scenario similar to the high-usage training cases.
